sources: Bhattacharya, Ghosh, Monsivais, Dunbar & Kaski (2016), Sex differences in social focus across the life cycle in humans, Royal Society Open Science 3(4) – call records of 3.2 million mobile phone users in one European country (2007); the number of contacts peaks at around age 25 for both sexes, then declines and plateaus from about 45 to 55, then declines again.
Hall (2019), How many hours does it take to make a friend?, Journal of Social and Personal Relationships 36(4) – about 200+ hours together for a close friend.
